newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Blackmores says Q1 net up 17.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Blackmores says Q1 net up 17.4 pct.

text.p: Health products maker Blackmores Ltd said on Monday profit after tax was 17.4 percent higher at A$1.216 million in the three months to September 30, 1996.

Blackmores said sales rose 2.3 percent in the first quarter to A$15.67 million. It said the operating margin, the ratio of profit before interest and tax to sales, was 12.6 percent for the quarter compared to 10.3 percent a year earlier.
"Whilst the results of the first three months of this year have been pleasing, retail sales generally remain flat," managing director Marcus Blackmore said in statement.
"Although we have performed satisfactorily, we still remain cautious about the balance of the year," Blackmore said.

Blackmore said the focus remained on maintaining the brand's premium position which would be done through increased advertising support and focusing on containing and reducing costs in the current low-growth environment.
"This will ensure sustained profitability and continued good cash flow to enable us to maintain healthy dividends," he said.
At 12.35 p.m. (0135 GMT), Blackmores shares were one cent higher at A$3.16.
